description: Vectors for contracts/types.md section 2 (body word count and example fences). EVERY implementation that reads the section 2 rule must run every row (ADR-060, ticket T52). Each row is derived from the section 2 definition, not copied from any implementation output. Everything is ASCII: non-ASCII characters are JSON unicode escapes so no editor can normalise them (U+F900 must stay U+F900). body is the raw text to count; fixture (instead of body) is a path under contracts/fixtures/ whose frontmatter is dropped. words is the section 2 count of the body after example fences are removed; examples is the trimmed content of each example fence, in order. covers lists the categories a row exercises; basis says where the number comes from (s2-key-table, s2-vector-table, s2-definition, ruling-b, fixture, gherkin-p1); why is the derivation in one sentence. Since contracts 1.5.0 (ADR-081, ticket T57) which fences count as example fences is defined by the card screen block parser (markdown-it 15.0.1), and the rows with basis s2-fence-1.5.0 hold those fence shapes. Optional strippedBody is the exact body after the example fences are removed and the whole is trimmed; it is checked byte for byte when present.
